task_context.problem_statement:
def count_up_to(n):
    """Implement a function that takes an non-negative integer and returns an array of the first n
    integers that are prime numbers and less than n.
    for example:
    count_up_to(5) => [2,3]
    count_up_to(11) => [2,3,5,7]
    count_up_to(0) => []
    count_up_to(20) => [2,3,5,7,11,13,17,19]
    count_up_to(1) => []
    count_up_to(18) => [2,3,5,7,11,13,17]
    """

Using a boolean flag is a very common and effective way to handle this. You set it to True initially, and if you find a divisor, you switch it to False and break the inner loop. Once the inner loop finishes, you can check that flag to decide whether to add the number to your list.
